status: None of these sources supplies the requested universal upper bound or a proved transfer to it.
source_policy: Technical conclusions below are based on primary papers, not search-result summaries alone.

entries.title: Betti numbers of semi-algebraic sets defined by multi-degree constraints
entries.mechanism: Bounds on components of sign conditions using separate parameter blocks and their separate degrees.
entries.application: The two-block estimate in mechanism-audit.tex gives a full-model lower bound with asymptotic constant one. It also excludes low-rank denominator directions, adaptive moment-curve nodes, and uniformly mild conditioning/margin as universal compressed constructions.
entries.gap: A sign-pattern upper count is a lower-bound method for head complexity. It provides no universal existence construction.

entries.title: The capacity of feedforward neural networks
entries.mechanism: Capacity estimates for layered threshold networks.
entries.gap: The dimensional hypotheses used for the relevant asymptotics do not cover exponentially many hidden units relative to input dimension. Counting many functions is also weaker than representing every function, and a threshold activation is not an admissible head value.

entries.title: Exact hyperplane covers for subsets of the hypercube
entries.authors: Scott Aaronson, Carla Groenland, Andrzej Grzesik, Tom Johnston, Dawid Kielak
entries.checked_location: Theorem 2, Lemmas 9 and 10, and their proofs
entries.mechanism: Hamming-neighborhood covers and a count of hyperplane intersection patterns.
entries.gap: The universal upper bound has order 2^n/n. The lower bound has order 2^n/n^2. Moreover a hyperplane equality predicate cannot simply be inserted as a flat-valued head and combined by an assumed free OR operation.

entries.title: Explicit exponential lower bounds for exact hyperplane covers
entries.authors: Benjamin E. Diamond and Amir Yehudayoff
entries.mechanism: Communication complexity gives explicit subsets with exponentially large exact cover number.
entries.gap: This is a lower bound for a different covering resource, not a universal construction at the requested scale.

entries.title: Dimension of projections in Boolean functions
entries.checked_location: Theorem 2 and definition of a projection
entries.mechanism: Find monochromatic projections defined by fixed coordinates and equal or complementary coordinate identifications.
entries.gap: The guaranteed dimension is around log_2(n), not 2 log_2(n). This does not provide arbitrary-label cells of quadratic size or an admissible-head compiler.

entries.title: Stability for hyperplane covers
entries.authors: Shagnik Das, Valjak Djaljapayan, Yen-Chi Roger Lin, Wei-Hsuan Yu
entries.checked_location: Weighted hyperplane inequality and its equality and stability conditions
entries.mechanism: The vertex weight 1/(|x| binomial(n,|x|)) bounds the weight of a hyperplane avoiding the origin.
entries.gap: Almost covers and multiplicity covers do not supply target-dependent monochromatic exact covers of arbitrary subsets. No head-count upper bound follows.

entries.title: Polynomial threshold functions and Boolean threshold circuits
entries.authors: Kristoffer Arnsfelt Hansen and Vladimir V. Podolskii
entries.mechanism: Compare maxima of affine input statistics, then lift a strict exponent winner to a signed exponential sum.
entries.gap: An exponential of an affine input statistic is a product over input coordinates. It is not an affine numerator or denominator. The dominant-power head construction instead takes maxima over active coefficient exponents and has a different feasibility problem.

entries.title: Sign conditions for injectivity of generalized polynomial maps with applications to chemical reaction networks and real algebraic geometry
entries.authors: Stefan Mueller, Elisenda Feliu, Georg Regensburger, Carsten Conradi, Anne Shiu, Alicia Dickenstein
entries.checked_location: Theorems 1.4 and 1.5, especially the existence clause of Theorem 1.5
entries.mechanism: Oriented-matroid conditions on maximal minors give injectivity and, with additional hypotheses, positive solutions in a specified cone.
entries.gap: Arbitrary Boolean label cones do not automatically satisfy the required matching-minor signs. Establishing the relevant compatibility at the requested head count remains a theorem-strength gap.

entries.title: Unit signatures in real biquadratic and multiquadratic number fields
entries.authors: David S. Dummit and Hershy Kisilevsky
entries.checked_location: Definitions of signature and deficiency, Proposition 1, and the introductory statements of the main constructions
entries.mechanism: Real embeddings of a multiquadratic field are indexed by Boolean sign choices, so algebraic signatures form Boolean tables.
entries.gap: The constructions concern multiplicative unit groups and extraction of square roots. These operations have no established small-head compilation. Signature rank can also be deficient; unrestricted signature universality must not be assumed for units.

entries.title: Erzeugungsgrad, VC-dimension and neural networks with rational activation function
entries.authors: Luis Miguel Pardo and Daniel Sebastian
entries.checked_location: Introduction and scope of constructible families
entries.mechanism: Intersection theory relates algebraic dimension and classification capacity through generation degree.
entries.gap: A capacity bound or dimension comparison does not prove that the fixed Boolean cube is shattered by the manuscript's constrained rational family.

entries.title: Network size and weights size for memorization with two-layers neural networks
entries.authors: Sebastien Bubeck, Ronen Eldan, Yin Tat Lee, Dan Mikulincer
entries.checked_location: Introduction, general-position condition, and stated memorization bounds
entries.mechanism: Threshold and ReLU memorization at the number-of-points divided by input-dimension scale; complex recombination controls weights in approximation.
entries.gap: The scale is 2^n/n, the cube fails the stated general-position condition, and the activations differ from admissible affine ratios.

entries.title: The real tropical geometry of neural networks
entries.authors: Marie-Charlotte Brandenburg, Georg Loho, Guido Montufar
entries.checked_location: Classification regions and the distinction between real and tropical parameter geometry
entries.mechanism: Tropical inequalities organize classification regions and reveal nonconvexity.
entries.gap: The geometry alone does not assert a solution for every labeling or provide positive affine denominators with the required head count.
